selection_basis: Visual inspection of the original normalised clip only, before any classical or generative output. Frame 398 is a strong perspective/roll view with the four corners at or inside the image boundary; later cropped frames are excluded. Frames 30,45,145 contain foreground. Some poster corners are occluded by the folder and require manual estimation from visible edges.
annotation_author: Hoang Bach; 10 corner frames and 5 masks saved through the supplied GUI before inference

artwork_review.notes: Generic burger advertisement with a small cartoon burger face at the top; no visible named third-party brand or human face. Converted to PNG with black letterboxing at exact board aspect ratio; no cropping, stretching or content edits.
